$schema_note: Declarative branch policy for 10xdev4u-alt/quayline. Applied by scripts/configure_branch_protection.sh. The two top level objects map onto two different GitHub API surfaces, and conflating them is the main way this goes wrong. See docs/decisions/0001-protection-is-two-api-surfaces.md.

repository.$comment: PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}. Merge methods live only on this surface.
repository.$allow_squash_merge: False. AGENTS.md section eight prohibits squash with no exceptions. Verified live on 2026-09-27: a squash merge is refused with 'the base branch policy prohibits the merge' while GET /branches/main/protection returns 404. The refusal is real and comes from here. The classic branch protection API has no field for merge methods, so a script that only writes protection leaves squash available and the refusal comes from somewhere else.

branch_protection.$comment: PUT /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection. Everything the repository settings cannot express.

required_status_checks.$comment: The context is the job name in .github/workflows/gate.yml, which is 'make validate'. Not the workflow name, which is 'gate'. Getting this wrong makes every pull request permanently unmergeable: the check reports under one name, the rule requires another, so the requirement is never satisfied and never blocks.
required_status_checks.$strict: True, which requires the branch to be current with its base before merging. Without it a green check can be reporting on a commit that is no longer on the branch. That is the same defect class as the hook in issue 76 that was configured, installed, and enforcing nothing.

required_pull_request_reviews.$comment: At least one approval, from a named account, on a branch that is up to date.
required_pull_request_reviews.$required_approving_review_count: One, not two. An author cannot approve their own pull request, so on a two account repository requiring two approvals means no change can ever merge. The second account's approval is what makes the count of one sufficient.
required_pull_request_reviews.$require_code_owner_reviews: True, and this is what restricts approval to the two named accounts, because this API has no approver allowlist. Combined with .github/CODEOWNERS it means an approval from any other account does not satisfy the requirement. This field is the approver allowlist.

branch_protection.$required_linear_history: False. This is a false value that looks like a bug. True forces squash or rebase merging, which is precisely what AGENTS.md section two prohibits. The field reads as 'keep the history linear' and actually means 'refuse merge commits'.
branch_protection.$restrictions: Null means any collaborator with push access may push to main. That is a deliberate acceptance. Restricting to one account would mean the other cannot open a hotfix, and the review requirement already covers the risk this would address. Set to an object with 'users' to tighten.

codeowners.$comment: The two accounts AGENTS.md section one names as owner and reviewer. With require_code_owner_reviews true, an approval from anyone outside this list does not satisfy the requirement.
